    // some common functions
    function sbInp_clearPlaceholder(sbox) {
        sbox = $(sbox);
        if (sbox.hasClass('searchBoxEmpty')) {
            sbox.removeClass('searchBoxEmpty').val('').removeAttr('placeholder');
        }
    }
    function sbInp_syncPlaceholder(sbox) {
        sbox = $(sbox);
        sbox.removeClass('searchBoxEmpty');
        var emptyText = sbox.attr('data-empty');
        if ($.trim(sbox.val()).length == 0 || $.trim(sbox.val()) == emptyText) {
            sbox.addClass('searchBoxEmpty').val(emptyText).attr('placeholder', emptyText);
        }
    }

<div class="item-content"> <h3 class="item-title"><a href="https://www.aacnnursing.org/aacn50th/Gallery" title="AACN’s Anniversary Gala: An Evening to Remember">AACN’s Anniversary Gala: An Evening to Remember</a></h3>
<div class="item-description"><p>Photos from AACN’s 50<sup>th</sup> Anniversary Gala are now available for download! <a href="https://www.aacnnursing.org/aacn50th/Gallery">View the photo gallery and download photos here</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="bg-color" style="background-color:#1c8c7e"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion-item" style="width: 12.5%;">
<div class="bg-image" style='background-image:url("https://www.aacnnursing.org/Portals/42/DNNGalleryPro/uploads/2019/8/21/bacc.png")'></div>
<div class="item-content"> <h3 class="item-title"><a href="http://www.aacnnursing.org/featured/1608/details" title="Join Us in Orlando for the Latest Trends in Baccalaureate Education">Join Us in Orlando for the Latest Trends in Baccalaureate Education</a></h3>
<div class="item-description"><p>Whether you are a new or seasoned faculty member, dean, an aspiring leader, or in an associate/assistant dean role, this is a conference you cannot miss! <b><a href="https://www.aacnnursing.org/Featured/1608/details">Register Online</a></b></p>
</div>
<div class="bg-color" style="background-color:#127998"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion-item" style="width: 12.5%;">
<div class="bg-image" style='background-image:url("https://www.aacnnursing.org/Portals/42/DNNGalleryPro/uploads/2019/10/20/Copy%20of%20Transform-Card_1.png")'></div>
<div class="item-content"> <h3 class="item-title"><a href="https://www.aacnnursing.org/transform" title="Transform 2020">Transform 2020</a></h3>
<div class="item-description"><p>Save the date for the first national conference for faculty teaching in baccalaureate and/or master’s nursing programs.</p>
</div>
<div class="bg-color" style="background-color:#1c8c7e"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion-item" style="width: 12.5%;">
<div class="bg-image" style='background-image:url("https://www.aacnnursing.org/Portals/42/DNNGalleryPro/uploads/2019/10/11/doctoral%20slider.png")'></div>
<div class="item-content"> <h3 class="item-title"><a href="https://www.aacnnursing.org/Featured/1611/details" title="Break Through Barriers at the Doctoral Education Conference">Break Through Barriers at the Doctoral Education Conference</a></h3>
<div class="item-description"><p>Join us in January and explore how to build a bridge to a better future for doctoral education. <strong><a href="https://www.aacnnursing.org/Featured/1611/details">Learn more.</a></strong></p>
</div>
<div class="bg-color" style="background-color:#2647a4"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion-item" style="width: 12.5%;">
<div class="bg-image" style='background-image:url("https://www.aacnnursing.org/Portals/42/DNNGalleryPro/uploads/2019/10/11/50th-Program-Book_2.png")'></div>
<div class="item-content"> <h3 class="item-title"><a href="https://www.dropbox.com/s/nozu0wvbq4v8c5b/AACN-50th-Anniversary-Program.pdf?dl=0" title="Our 50th Anniversary Program Book">Our 50th Anniversary Program Book</a></h3>
<div class="item-description"><p>Featuring thoughts on AACN’s past and future, historical photos, remembrances from past AACN presidents and chairs, greetings from industry leaders, and well wishes from more than 150 member schools of nursing.</p>
</div>
<div class="bg-color" style="background-color:#1c8c7e"></div>

<script>
// CODE FOR 50TH BANNER LOGO
function isCollision() {
	var rect = document.getElementsByClassName("dnn_logo")[0];
	var dragMe = document.getElementsByClassName("page-utility")[0];

	var object_1 = dragMe.getBoundingClientRect();
	var object_2 = rect.getBoundingClientRect();

	if (object_1.left < object_2.left + object_2.width && object_1.left + object_1.width > object_2.left && object_1.top < object_2.top + object_2.height && object_1.top + object_1.height > object_2.top) {
    //console.log('true');
		$('.dnn_logo').css('padding', '55px 0 0 0');
	} else {
    //console.log('false');
		$('.dnn_logo').css('padding', '20px 0');
	}
}

$(window).on("resize", function() {
	isCollision();
}).resize();
</script>
